messages:
maya (AE): Quick help — APAC POC (HealthGrid) pinned to "rdx-medium-v1" but seeing model_not_found and occasional 429s. They need pinned semantics for eval.

omar (Sales-Eng): Do we have request ids? Also they asked about a 1-week dedicated trial (1 GPU) pricing and KMS notes.

maya (AE): req hg_44a and hg_44b. They say fallback to "rdx-medium-quant-v1" changes phrasing. Data residency is important.

dev (SRE): Checked logs: ap-southeast only has quant copies for that model family; full weights not provisioned -> model_not_found. Fallback routing causes the 429 bursts.

lee (Platform-SE): Short-term options: 1) enforce strict pin so SDK errors fast (header: x-redwood-strict-model: true), 2) route to eu-west (latency hit), or 3) spin ephemeral full model replica in APAC.

maya (AE): Customer won't route out of region. Can infra do ephemeral replica for 1 week? What's ETA & cost?

infra-bot: quota-check: requested ap-southeast-1:1xA100. Capacity check: likely OK. Approval required. Est. lead time 4-6h after approval.

omar (Sales-Eng): Pricing ballpark for 1 A100, 1 week in APAC: ~$1.8k-$2.8k. I'll prepare a one-pager quote.

kira (Security): Security blurb: Dedicated/Private supports customer-managed KMS; Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys. We provide audit logs and SOC2 artifacts under NDA. I can draft exact language.

dev (SRE): If they want to proceed immediately, ask them to set x-redwood-strict-model: true to get deterministic model_not_found rather than silent fallback while we provision.

maya (AE): Thanks — I'll propose strict-header as interim and send the quote for a 1-week ephemeral. Keeping thread open until customer confirms. :+1:
